Critical Mass Houston

Houston, TX · East End · Social

Critical Mass Houston is a social group ride in Houston, TX. It rolls last Friday of the month at 7:15 pm from Guadalupe Plaza Park. Pace: slow, all skill levels. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow, all skill levels. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @criticalmasshtx the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Critical Mass Houston group ride

A casual monthly ride from Guadalupe Plaza Park east of downtown, going wherever, ending somewhere fun around 9:30 or 10. Rain or shine. Bring lights and a helmet.
